oracle.statement: on a self-created collection with a verified keyword index, every well-formed DELETE index answers HTTP 200 with a result:object envelope: existing index cat; never-indexed unknown field; already-deleted field repeated (idempotence); dotted-path field lvl.tag (200 required whether the create succeeded - existing branch - or was refused - non-existent idempotent branch, the assertion promises 200 either way); and with documented optional query params wait=true + timeout=30 present; any 4xx on these legal deletes = Type1_IllegalRejection; 5xx = Type3 after /healthz re-check; 200 with non-object result = Type4 (response_shape result:object); a refused dotted-path create is a measured note about the create face, not this face (G3/G10); transport/setup = SCRIPT_ERROR (G8)
